new_leads.name: NVIDIA Nemotron ASR Saudi dialect fine-tuning
new_leads.finding: First-party technical Sep30 account of Najdi/Hijazi speech adaptation using NeMo with 133.7 hours. Publisher reports WER 55.05% to 29.96% on its selected test split, not external reproduction.
new_leads.scope: Technical practitioner tutorial, may be less material than model launches; validate model/dataset and full test methodology before Selection.

new_leads.name: NVIDIA VSS Blueprint 3.3 visual agent serving
new_leads.finding: First-party Sep29 technical release adds Build Vision Agent skill and Adaptive Efficient Video Sampling to compose VLM+RAG+MCP video workflows; vendor states 80% fewer visual input tokens and 46% more concurrent streams in its demonstrated conditions.
new_leads.scope: Vendor-specific demo; do not generalize efficiency without matching video workload and GPU/model configuration.

new_leads.name: NVIDIA NeMo Relay agent trace/observability
new_leads.finding: First-party Sep30 technical post introduces ATOF lifecycle streams, ATIF step trajectories and OpenTelemetry/OpenInference spans with Hermes integration.
new_leads.scope: Tracing instrumentation examples do not independently establish end-to-end reliability or security.

new_leads.name: AMD Ross embedded-system design agent
new_leads.finding: First-party Sep30 AMD introduction covers documentation/commands/debug/workflow guidance across Vivado, Vitis, Vitis HLS, Vitis AI and ROCm AI.
new_leads.scope: Product coverage and claimed design cycle acceleration are promotional; architecture, access and validated metrics require further examination.

new_leads.name: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB announcement
new_leads.finding: Vendor article date Oct2 announces 64GB unified-memory SKU and Nvidia Sync Cluster Assistant; planned third-party availability Oct23, not already shipping during W40.
new_leads.scope: The article lacks confirmed publication time relative to W40 22:00 UTC cutoff. HOLD timestamp until precise publication evidence.

checks: Audio (F) had a Sep30 technical item. Prior GROK 'quiet' claim disproven at discovery level.
Video/visual AI (D/E) had Sep29 NVIDIA VSS 3.3; not a new generative video foundation model.
Independent reproducibility and generalizability of vendor benchmarks not established.
Search for hardware announcements on Oct2 requires full cutoff time, not just calendar date.
Broader open-weight, research benchmark, security and audio/video completeness checks still required.
